one_liner: Watches the chain block by block and delivers each matching event to a real Telegram channel — tx hash, explorer link, value, block number — exactly once.
what_it_does: This lamp watches a chosen address for incoming transfers and the moment one lands, it sends a real message to a Telegram channel with the details. It sends each event exactly once, even across restarts. Proven by 1 real trigger transaction plus 1 real delivered Telegram alert on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
